Work & related roles

Professional experience, internships and relevant student responsibilities are labelled separately.

Internship · Dec 2024 - Jun 2025

Energy Efficiency Intern · Alleima

Developed and independently validated a quantitative methodology for industrial energy performance mapping, covering KPI/EnPI design, load-driver logic, metering-gap assessment, deviation detection from noisy operational data and regulatory comparison. The work was desk-based method development and decision-support framing rather than hands-on plant execution, with electrical utilities and compressed air treated as relevant electrification pathways. Proprietary site detail is not republished.

Python · ISO 50001 · EU EED · KPI/EnPI Design · Energy Performance Mapping · Industrial Energy Analysis · Structured Reporting

Scope & limitations

Alleima work was desk-based method development, not implementation of plant savings. Proprietary site detail is excluded. Demonstration emissions factors and KPI alerts are not compliance advice or root-cause diagnoses.

This dossier groups related public records. It does not imply equal depth across every tool or independent validation of every result. Source case studies remain authoritative; restricted inputs and private documents are not included.
